name: Tourist Visa (TS) / e-Visa

requirements.blocker_text: The Kyrgyz Ministry of Foreign Affairs' Tourist (TS) visa is valid up to 60 days and costs $40-50, the lowest-cost visa category in the country's own 15+ category system. Eligible nationalities may instead apply through the government's e-visa portal (evisa.e-gov.kg). Standard processing is 7 working days (3 days expedited, double fee). Passport must have 6+ months' validity and at least 2 blank pages.
requirements.fix_path: Apply for a Tourist (TS) visa at a Kyrgyz consulate, or via the e-visa portal if your nationality is eligible.

evidence_required.document: Valid passport (6+ months validity, 2+ blank pages)
Completed application form and photograph (or scanned documents for e-visa)

outcome.duration_length: up to 60 days (Tourist/TS); e-visa portal separately lists up to 30 days for its Tourist category

sources.title: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Kyrgyz Republic -- consular visa categories: Tourist (TS) visa, fees, processing time, requirements
Kyrgyz Republic e-Visa government portal -- 19 visa categories including Tourist (TS, up to 30 days), eligibility requirements

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Kyrgyzstan). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- both cited sources are genuine .gov.kg government domains (the Ministry of Foreign Affairs' own consular page and the government's own e-visa portal), a materially stronger sourcing result than most countries built earlier in this dataset, where tourist-visa routes typically relied on tier-3/4 consultancy sites. GENUINE, DISCLOSED DISCREPANCY BETWEEN TWO TIER-1 SOURCES: the MFA's own consular page states the Tourist (TS) visa is valid up to 60 days, while the government's own e-visa portal separately lists its Tourist category as valid up to 30 days -- both are official government sources and this dataset does not resolve the conflict by picking one arbitrarily; it is disclosed as-is. This may reflect a genuine distinction between a consulate-issued visa and the newer e-visa product, or simply outdated content on one of the two government pages -- this build could not determine which.
